description: Opt-in for pnpm repos, on top of default. Consumed as local>bluesky-social/.github//renovate/pnpm#v1. Only for repos where pnpm itself enforces the cooldown: pnpm >= 11 (dependency build scripts blocked unless listed in allowBuilds), minimumReleaseAge: 4320 in pnpm-workspace.yaml (applies to transitive dependencies too), and packageManager pinned in package.json.

packageRules.description: Renovate's security PRs only bump dependencies declared in package.json; transitive fixes land through the weekly lock file refresh. fix: so it releases.

pnpm >= 11 with minimumReleaseAge meets the bar for trusting npm minors: no dependency install scripts by default, and a cooldown on every package including transitives. Toolchain entries the npm manager also reports (engines.node, packageManager pnpm) are excluded so their minors stay manual, as in default.
